name: How long do deck structural repairs usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long do deck structural repairs usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of deck structural repairs depends on the complexity and scope of the project. Minor repairs might take a few days, while extensive structural overhauls could extend to a week or more. Factors such as weather conditions and material availability can also influence the timeline. We aim to complete repairs efficiently while ensuring the highest quality of workmanship.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies; minor repairs take days, extensive overhauls can take over a week, depending on scope and conditions.
